visualCharacteristics.purpose: an embedded third-party player: YouTube video or Lufthansa in-flight entertainment widget
traits: YouTube: 16:9 player over the content width (youtube-nocookie.com)
in-flight entertainment widget: 520px high, at most 1240px wide

contentPattern.structure: One row, one cell: the link to the video or widget. A link text other than the URL is the player title

usage: Lufthansa video component (.video .video-player, YouTube iframe) and iframe component with the in-flight entertainment widget (.iframe .iframe-wrapper).
reuseGuidance: Inside accordion-columns panels and columns-media cells the same link alone in a paragraph becomes the player; use this block elsewhere. Videos hosted as .mp4 files are columns-media (poster + link).
